title: First AI Gaming Festival?
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
The only way to break the stigma of AI Gaming and Slop, is to show them that AI != necessarily mean slop.

In fact, their are many different ways AI can be used should be highlighted that artwork is not everything. So here is a festival just for that:

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4UHHYGeGWVJf64W92IYSL1rrKa9LYiktTmh8E\_K0oEAJIiA/viewform?usp=header](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4UHHYGeGWVJf64W92IYSL1rrKa9LYiktTmh8E_K0oEAJIiA/viewform?usp=header)

Please both share with other AI developers and sign your game-up and let's start to change the perception of AI.

comments.author: DatabaseConstant7870
comments.body: Where do you submit the actual game link? Or upload game? I see it says steam ID but not everyone wants to put their game on steam

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Steam ID is optional. I noticed a lot of AI games are web based, so we could do a web based + steam

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: Well I’m just wondering is that form where we submit the game or are you gonna send out emails later on asking people to submit

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Yes that will process for now, first  there needs to be a good amount of games, and most importantly quality games.

comments.author: AnimalPowers
comments.body: eh… slop is less about how it’s made and the integrity and intent behind and skill behind the developer.    slop is slop.   if a chef makes poop soup, it’s still poop soup.  the slop in the slop part is the slop and has little to do with AI.  the problem is people use AI and claim they can do things they can’t, and produce slop.    it’s a skill issue not a tech issue.   I don’t really see what’s to gain from this sort of festival… seems likely to drive a lot of slop

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body: This sounds fantastic. Lmk if you need logistical help. I've set up events with 1000+ attended and have handled everything from sponsorships to  full run of show

comments.author: I-want-to-say
comments.body: Would you be so kind and introduce your organization and tell how and where do you plan to host the festival?

comments.author: bitbutter
comments.body: unless ai is being used for something really ground breaking, this doesn't seem relevant to game-buyers. ai can help ship faster, better, more throughoughly tested stuff, but none of those advantages are relevant to the buyer looking for the next interesting game to try. why would they be interested in an ai festival? (uh, except to blacklist participants maybe).
